name: Cuneiform
description: Wedges pressed into clay, each one turned to a different quarter.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { color: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); line-height: 1; text-align: center; font-size: 150%; :after { content: "\@hex(@pick(9666, 9656, 9650, 9660))"; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 20deg, -20deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 20deg, -20deg)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
